_comment: Fog of war toggled mid-battle (seed 20414, whole field in view). Staged: the player's Cavalry (uid 1, at 500,300, mounted sight 21 m = 420 wu), an enemy Infantry block 240 wu south of it (uid 2, inside the cavalry's sight) and an enemy Archers block far away in the south-east corner (uid 3, outside every friendly disc). Tick 90: F7 switches fog on -- the far Archers vanish, the near Infantry stays, and the FOG OF WAR indicator appears under the order-mode banner. Tick 150/170: select the Cavalry and order it to the north-west corner; it sprints away while the Infantry plods after it, so the gap opens past 420 wu and the Infantry drops out of sight, leaving a red ghost outline (at the last-seen spot and facing) that fades over the next ten seconds. Tick 840: F7 switches fog off again -- both enemies reappear where they actually are, and the ghost goes. Driven live through the real HUD/SelectionManager by tools/demo/DemoInputRecorder.gd; world coordinates; physics ticks (60/s).
